intl.title: Rutgers Admissions - Required Credentials for International Applicants

test_policy.notes: Rutgers-New Brunswick is test optional (SAT/ACT optional; no disadvantage if not submitted); policy stated through 2027. SAT EBRW 650+ or ACT reading 28+ (if sent to Rutgers) exempts students from the English placement exam.

requirements.supplemental_essays: None. One short original essay inside the application (Common App 250-650 words, or 3,800 characters on the Rutgers Application); a short extra statement only if applying to Honors.
requirements.notes: Platforms: Common App or the Rutgers Application (own); submit only one. Letters of recommendation are not used. STARS self-reported transcript required for current seniors. Mason Gross School of the Arts requires a portfolio/audition/interview. Application fee amount not stated on the pages opened this session (left blank).

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding), fall 2027
deadlines.notes: Decision by Jan 31: admitted, not admitted, wait list, or deferred to RD.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision, fall 2027
deadlines.notes: Must apply by Dec 1 to be considered for honors and merit scholarships. Later applications are reviewed on a space-available rolling basis. Mason Gross applicants hear by April 1.

deadlines.label: Candidate reply date
deadlines.notes: Applies to both EA and RD admits.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required for applicants whose secondary schooling was outside the U.S. in a country where English is not the principal language. Case-by-case waivers for English-medium schooling (RUinternational@admissions.rutgers.edu); B or better in a U.S. college English Composition course also exempts. Alternative qualifying scores: SAT EBRW 550, ACT English 21, MET 56. Scores must be under two years old and sent directly by the testing agency.

english.notes: Old 0-120 scale, tests through 2026-01-21. Pharmacy and Nursing require 100.
New scale, tests from 2026-01-22. Pharmacy and Nursing require 5.5. No section minimums listed.

aid.notes: All admitted first-year international students on non-immigrant visas are automatically considered for Rutgers international merit scholarships ($5,000-$16,000 per year, four years, 3.25 GPA to renew); no separate application. Apply by the EA or RD date to be considered.

ielts.note: No IELTS code published; scores must be sent directly from the testing service to Rutgers.

duolingo.note: No Duolingo code published on the page opened.

tier_notes.humanities: Philosophy is one of the top US departments.
